title: A Vanilla Overlay
body:
## Note

> "A Vanilla Overlay" is made for a cleaner visibility while playing PvP, but can of course also be used for Survival.
> This Resource Pack is made by me, 0rbix, but some assets are taken from Vanilla Tweaks and Cobweb Outlines (see Credits).

## Features

- Low Fire
- Low Shield
- Short Grass
- Visible Tripwire
- Visible Powder Snow
- Visible Trapped Chest
- Smaller Totem in Hand
- 3D End Crystal
- Cobweb Outlines
- Cleaner End Crystals 
- Cleaner Attack Indicator
- Cleaner Enchantmend Glint
- Cleaner End Gateway/Beacon Beam
- Cleaner Effect Particle
- Cleans up names
- Clear Water
- No Leaf Particle
- No Explosion Particle
- No Fire Particle
- No Vignette
- Less Rain/Snow Particle
- Ore Borders
- Colored Ping
- No Pumpkin Blur
- Bow/Crossbow Charging Animation
- Black End Sky
